category_title: Grade 1 students who struggle with writing and self-regulation but benefit from oral discourse
scenario_title: Distraction with physical tools during transition to discussion
minimal_context: Joshua and his partner are transitioning to the carpet for a whole-class discussion about their work with spring scales.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please come sit on the carpet with your partner for our whole-class discussion, and leave your spring scale on the floor in front of you.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits on the carpet with his partner but picks up the spring scale instead of leaving it on the floor.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Joshua, remember where the tool is supposed to go.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Keeps holding the spring scale in his hands as the class discussion begins.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to pay attention to the class right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Begins playing with the spring scale, touching it and looking at it rather than focusing on the discussion.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please come sit on the carpet with your partner for our whole-class discussion, and leave your spring scale on the floor in front of you.

STUDENT: (Sits on the carpet with his partner but picks up the spring scale instead of leaving it on the floor.)

TUTOR: Joshua, remember where the tool is supposed to go.

STUDENT: (Keeps holding the spring scale in his hands as the class discussion begins.)

TUTOR: We need to pay attention to the class right now.

STUDENT: (Begins playing with the spring scale, touching it and looking at it rather than focusing on the discussion.)

task.content: Transition from pair work to whole-class discussion on the carpet using spring scales as tools.

context.social_setting: With his partner during a whole-class discussion
context.time_context: Transition from pair work to whole-class discussion

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Although the teacher had instructed pairs to leave it on the floor in front of them
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Joshua began playing with a spring scale... touching the scale rather than focusing on the discussion.

behavior_patterns.condition: During paired work, individual work, or whole-class discussions.
